events.verdict: {Observable in Enhanced Video} Payne (CHI) steps inside the three-point arc before the release of the free throw.
LaVine (CHI) makes contact with Bogdanovic's (IND) arm and affects his driving shot attempt.
Payne (CHI) is turned around during the screen by LaVine (CHI) and makes contact with Joseph (IND), but the contact is marginal.
LaVine (CHI) lifts his pivot foot at the start of his dribble.
Turner (IND) makes contact to the front of LaVine (CHI), but the contact is marginal and does not affect LaVine's SQBR.
Turner (IND) firms up and absorbs the contact from Payne (CHI) during the pick.
Payne (CHI) makes contact with Collison (IND) as he attempts to steal the ball, but the contact is marginal and does not affect Collison's SQBR.
Sabonis (IND) is in the paint for less than three seconds when he is imminently exiting.
Turner (IND) engages with Carter Jr. (CHI) and affects his FOM.
Joseph (IND) places his hands on LaVine (CHI), but immediately removes it.
LaVine (CHI) ends his dribble and takes two legal steps during his drive towards the basket.
Joseph (IND) maintains verticality on LaVine's (CHI) shot.
Turner (IND) clamps Carter Jr.'s (CHI) arm and affects his ability to get to the loose ball.
[Observable in enhanced video] Myles (IND) keeps his foot on the line for over three seconds.
Turner (IND) makes leg contact with LaVine (CHI) during the pick, but the contact is marginal.
Payne (CHI) makes contact with Turner's (IND) arm during the follow-through on his jump shot but does not affect his ability to follow-through naturally.
Sabonis (IND) is in the paint for less than three seconds when the shot is imminent.
Carter Jr. (CHI) commits a take foul on Collison (IND).
Carter Jr. (CHI) absorbs the contact from Sabonis (IND) during the screen.
Markkanen (CHI) commits a take foul on Collison (IND).
[Observable in enhanced video] LaVine (CHI) lifts his pivot foot at the start of his dribble.
Sabonis (IND) makes contact with LaVine's (CHI) body during the follow-through on his shot near the rim but does not affect his driving shot attempt.
Sabonis (IND) makes contact to Markkanen's (CHI) arm, but does not affect his shot attempt.
Payne (CHI) commits a take foul on Joseph (IND).
